reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Zinc Teca Trouble Serum Mask Sheet 4+1 Special Set
reviews.text: I really love the BRINGGREEN Zinc Teca Trouble Serum Mask Sheet! It instantly soothes my skin and helps calm redness and breakouts while leaving my face feeling refreshed and hydrated. The mask fits well and feels comfortable, and after using it, my skin looks clearer, smoother, and more balanced. It’s perfect for a quick skin reset. 💚✨
reviews.zh: 我真心好鍾意 BRINGGREEN Zinc Tega Trouble Serum Mask Sheet！用完即刻令皮膚感到舒緩，有助鎮靜泛紅同暗瘡，仲令塊面感覺清爽同水潤。面膜好貼面、好舒服，用完之後皮膚望落去更加清透、更加滑、更加平衡。最適合想快速reset皮膚嘅時候用。💚✨

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Zinc Teca Trouble Serum Mask Sheet 4+1 Special Set
reviews.text:
The sheet itself is like plastic jelly, doesn't soak up enough serum and very easy to break. 
The size of the sheet is very small too.
I feel like I should have just bought the serum not these sheet masks.
reviews.zh:
面膜本身好似塑膠jelly，吸唔到足夠嘅精華，而且好容易爛。
面膜嘅size都好細。
我覺得不如直接買精華好過。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Zinc Teca Trouble Serum Mask Sheet 4+1 Special Set
reviews.text: This sheet mask is different from all the other ones I’ve tried. The mask itself is clear, translucent. Almost like thick Saran Wrap. It rips easily. Slimy. Not very moisturizing but I can feel it working.
reviews.zh: 呢款片裝面膜同我試過嘅其他完全唔同。面膜本身係透明、半透明，幾乎好似厚厚嘅保鮮紙。好容易撕爛。好滑溜。保濕效果一般，但感覺到佢有喺度work。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Zinc Teca Trouble Serum Mask Sheet 4+1 Special Set
reviews.text: I have acne prone, sensitive skin. I’m always afraid to try new things because my face reacts badly to a lot of products but this mask cause no troubles at all. I was put off by the strong scent when I first opened the package and to be honest, I almost threw it but it felt cooling and soothing and the tea tree smell didn’t linger. One of the best mask I’ve tried so far.
reviews.zh: 我係容易生暗瘡嘅敏感肌。因為塊面對好多產品都反應唔好，所以一直都好怕試新嘢，但呢款面膜完全冇引起任何皮膚問題。頭先打開包裝嘅時候被佢強烈嘅香味嚇親，老實講我差啲掉咗佢，但感覺涼涼地好舒緩，而且茶樹味都唔會殘留。暫時試過嘅面膜入面，呢款算係數一數二。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Zinc Teca Trouble Serum Mask Sheet 4+1 Special Set
reviews.text: I didn’t expect it to be a gel mask, but I’m not complaining. It’s amazing! I love gel masks and this was a pleasant surprise. Also, the mask was really effective and calmed down the redness right away. It’s super refreshing! 100/10
reviews.zh: 我本來冇預到佢係 gel mask，但係我都冇投訴。效果超正！我好鍾意 gel mask，今次真係一個驚喜。而且，呢款面膜真係好有效，敷完即刻退紅。超級清爽！100/10

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Zinc Teca Trouble Serum Mask Sheet 4+1 Special Set
reviews.text: I do find that after using this mask my skin feels calm, eases redness and reduces blemishes. However, personally I am not too fond of the texture of this mask, it’s like a very thin gel.. stays on well though but feels like it doesn’t have a lot of serum.
reviews.zh: 我用完呢款面膜之後，皮膚真係會感覺平靜，泛紅減退，暗瘡都少咗。不過，講到面膜嘅質地，我自己就唔係幾鍾意，似係好薄嘅啫喱……不過貼面度幾好，但係感覺精華唔算多。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Zinc Teca Trouble Serum Mask Sheet 4+1 Special Set
reviews.text: this is my favorite mask for calming down acne flareups. whenever i use it my skin is noticeably less irritated, and the redness around my breakouts is reduced. unlike some other masks that leave my skin feeling tight or dry after using, this one feels hydrating and nice. the ingredients seem to agree with my skin really well.
reviews.zh: 呢款係我紓緩暗瘡爆發嘅最愛面膜。每次用完，皮膚明顯冇咁受刺激，痘痘周圍嘅泛紅都減退咗。同其他用完之後會令皮膚覺得繃緊或者乾燥嘅面膜唔同，呢款用完感覺保濕又舒服。成分同我皮膚好似好夾。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Zinc Teca Trouble Serum Mask Sheet 4+1 Special Set
reviews.text:
I have acne-prone skin and often get pimples, which is why I chose this sheet mask—it helps soothe and calm irritation.

The mask is clear and has a slippery texture, making it a bit tricky to apply at first. The cutouts for the eyes, nose, and mouth are slightly oversized, so you may need to adjust it for a better fit. That said, its see-through design lets you easily unlock Face ID while wearing it, which is pretty convenient. :)

It has a refreshing tea tree oil scent and feels like serum in mask form, allowing the ingredients to stay on longer and work more effectively to calm the skin. I actually use the serum from the same line and absolutely love it, so I decided to try the mask when it was time to restock.

I leave it on for 15 minutes each time, and this is my second time using it. I’m really happy with how well it helps reduce breakouts and soothe inflammation.

Overall, I recommend this product to anyone looking for a new mask, especially those with oily or acne-prone skin.
reviews.zh:
我係暗瘡肌，又成日生暗瘡，所以揀咗呢款片裝面膜——佢可以幫助舒緩同鎮靜刺激。

面膜係透明嘅，質地滑潺潺，所以一開始有少少難貼。眼、鼻、口嘅開口位做得稍為大咗，所以可能要調整一下先貼得貼服。不過，佢嘅透明設計令你可以敷住輕鬆解鎖 Face ID，幾方便。:)

佢有種清新嘅茶樹油香味，感覺好似精華變成面膜咁，可以令成分留喺皮膚更耐，更有效咁鎮靜肌膚。其實我本身已經有用同一個系列嘅精華，勁鍾意，所以去到要補貨嘅時候就試埋呢款面膜。

我每次敷 15 分鐘，呢次係我第二次用。佢幫助減少爆瘡同舒緩炎症嘅效果真係令我好滿意。

整體嚟講，我會推薦呢款產品畀任何想搵新面膜嘅人，尤其係油性或者暗瘡肌。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
